Error('The database returned an unsupported tracking-domain status.');\n  }\n}\n\nfunction parseNetworkStatus(value: string): CatalogNetworkStatus {\n  switch (value) {\n    case 'active':\n    case 'suspended':\n    case 'archived':\n      return value;\n    default:\n      throw new Error('The database returned an unsupported network status.');\n  }\n}\n\nfunction parseOfferStatus(value: string): CatalogOfferStatus {\n  switch (value) {\n    case 'draft':\n    case 'active':\n    case

mapProvider(row: ProviderRow): CatalogProviderRecord {\n  if (row.status !== 'active' && row.status !== 'archived') {\n    throw new Error('The database returned an unsupported provider status.');\n  }\n\n  return Object.freeze({\n    id: row.id,\n    code: row.code,\n    name: row.name,\n    status: row.status,\n  });\n}\n\nfunction mapDomain(row: DomainRow): CatalogDomainRecord {\n  return Object.freeze({\n    id: row.id,\n    hostname: row.hostname,\n    status:

replaceManagerOfferAssignments(\n  transaction: DatabaseTransaction,\n  context: CatalogRepositoryContext,\n  offerId: string,\n  membershipIds: readonly string[],\n): Promise<void> {\n  await transaction.query({\n    name: 'catalog-operations-revoke-removed-manager-offer-assignments',\n    text: `\n      update public.offer_assignments as assignment\n      set\n        status = 'revoked',\n        updated_by = $3\n      from public.company_memberships as membership\n      where

current.fixedPayoutAmountMinor === normalizedInput.fixedPayoutAmountMinor &&\n        current.payoutCurrency === normalizedInput.payoutCurrency\n      ) {\n        throw new ApiHttpError(\n          'PAYOUT_PROFILE_UNCHANGED',\n          409,\n          'The payout profile already contains the requested values.',\n        );\n      }\n\n      if (normalizedInput.mode === 'per_offer') {\n        const incompleteAssignments = await repository.countOpenAssignmentsMissingManualPayout(\n

identity.companyMembership, companyId, [\n        'manager',\n        'publisher',\n      ]);\n\n      const membershipId = identity.companyMembership?.membershipId;\n\n      if (membershipId === undefined) {\n        throw new ApiHttpError(\n          'PAYOUT_PROFILE_NOT_FOUND',\n          404,\n          'The current user does not have a payout profile.',\n        );\n      }\n\n      const context = createRepositoryContext(identity, requestId, companyId);\n\n      await
